maxPieceCells.description: Largest piece dealt, in cells. 3 deals only 1-3 cell pieces (singles, dominoes, 3-bars, small Ls); 4 adds the 2x2 square and 4-long bars; 5 adds the 5-long bars and big Ls (6-8 behave as 5); 9 adds the 3x3 block (the game's default, every shape). Takes effect on the next pieces dealt.

piecesToPlace.description: Pieces placed before the tray refills its empty slots (the tray holds three). 1 refills after every placement, so there are always three pieces to choose from; 3 (the game's default) means using up the whole tray first, including awkward pieces. Applies immediately. Higher is harder.
